choices.why: This clean three-seat sofa in light fabric on birch legs is classic Nordic and fits along the left wall.
The bentwood birch rocking chair with a cream cushion makes a warm, light reading spot that matches the sofa legs.
This light ash table with tapered legs is the right size and matches the dining table from the same line.
The speckled wool rug in warm beige gives a cozy base and ties the seating area together without darkening it.
This light ash table seats six (two per side plus the ends) and keeps to the light-wood palette near the window.
Beech chairs with woven cord seats are warm and very Scandinavian, and they fit around the table.
The woven bamboo pendant adds natural warmth and texture over the dining table.
Its swing arm and white shade give soft, directed light for reading in the rocking chair.
This warm-wood sideboard with tapered legs and a textured front fits the Nordic mid-century look beside the dining area.
Light white linen curtains filter the window light without weighing down the room.
Cream and grey woven cushions with tassels add warm texture to the light sofa.
A cream cable-knit throw reinforces the warm, cozy textile feel.
The tall areca palm brings the requested green and fills the corner between the two zones.
A pair of black-and-white tree-line prints adds sober, Nordic contrast above the sofa.
Two matte stoneware vases in cream and sage add a soft touch to the table or sideboard.

answer.why: Light ash and birch woods, cream and beige textiles, and natural fibres like bamboo and paper cord create a warm, cohesive Nordic look against the white walls and oak floor. The palm and the sage vase add the touch of green.
